title: Saronic join card
description: A full-bleed 3:2 photo with a sonar-lime card docked 40px in from its bottom-right corner: mono caption with a dot, a large invitation and an ink-tinted external-link button at the foot. Phones put the photo on top and the lime block full-width under it.
notes: media is the photo; empty it is a placeholder
the card uses primary / primary-foreground, so it follows the theme's brand colour
